  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  DECEMBER 11, 2018

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Winterer at 6:03 p.m., on
  Tuesday, December 11, 2018, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Ted Winterer
  Mayor Pro Tem Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Terry O’Day
  Councilmember Tony Vazquez

  Absent:  Councilmember Pam O’Connor

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 6:03 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember O’Connor. Councilmember
  Vazquez led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  SPECIAL AGENDA  2.A. Recognition of outgoing Councilmember Pam O'Connor and
  ITEMS:  her 24-years of service, was presented.
  RECOGNITION OF
  COUNCILMEMBER PAM  Member of the public Aurelia Friedman, Fernando Morales (Representing
  O’CONNOR  Supervisor, Sheila Kuehl), and Colby Harriman (representing Senator Ben
  Allen) spoke in support.

  OFFICIAL CANVASS OF  2.B. Resolution No. 11154 (CCS) entitled, “RESOLUTION OF THE
  MUNICIPAL ELECTION  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SANTA MONICA ACCEPTING
  RESULTS  THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY REGISTRAR RECORDER/ COUNTY
  CLERK’S OFFICIAL CANVASS AND OFFICIAL STATEMENT OF
  VOTES CAST FOR THE CONSOLIDATED MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  HELD ON NOVEMBER 6, 2018, AND DECLARING THE RESULTS
  THEREOF,” was presented.

  Recommended Action
  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the resolution accepting the
  official canvass for the General Municipal Election held on November 6,

  1  December 11, 2018

  2018.

  There were no members present.

  Motion by Councilmember Vazquez, seconded by Councilmember O’Day,
  to adopt the resolution accepting the official canvass.

  The recommended motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers McKeown, Vazquez, Himmelrich, O’Day,
  Mayor Pro Tem Davis, Mayor Winterer
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: Councilmember O’Connor

  ADJOURNMENT OF  On order of the Mayor, the City Council, as presently constituted, was
  CURRENT COUNCIL  adjourned and the meeting was turned over to City Clerk Denise Anderson-
  Warren.

  SANTA MONICA  2.C. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica College
  COLLEGE BOARD  Board of Trustees Members, was presented.

  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly-
  elected Community College Board of Trustees Members Nancy Greenstein,
  Louise Jaffe, Sion Roy and Barry Snell.

  SANTA MONICA-  2.D. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica-Malibu
  MALIBU UNIFIED  Unified School Board Members, was presented.
  SCHOOL BOARD
  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly-
  elected Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School Board Member Oscar de la
  Torre.

  RENT CONTROL BOARD  2.E. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica Rent
  Control Board Members, was presented.

  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly-
  elected Rent Control Board Members Steve Duron and Naomi Sultan.

  CITY COUNCIL  2.F. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica City
  Councilmembers, was presented.

  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly-
  elected City Councilmembers Sue Himmelrich, Kevin McKeown and Greg
  Morena.

  2  December 11, 2018
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 2C11DB0B-C8CA-4222-BB06-6B4F636BF74B

  CONVENING OF THE  2.G.  Convening of new City Council, was presented.
  NEW CITY COUNCIL    Roll Call
  AND ELECTION OF    Election of Mayor for the ensuing two years
  MAYOR    Election of Mayor Pro Tem for the ensuing two years

  On order of the City Clerk, with the newly constituted City Council seated,
  the Council meeting was convened at 6:48 p.m., with all members present.

  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren opened the floor for nominations for
  Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem for the ensuing two years.

  Councilmember O’Day, nominated Councilmember Davis for Mayor

  Substitute motion by Councilmember Vazquez, seconded by
  Councilmember Himmelrich, to nominate Councilmember Gleam Davis for
  the first year as Mayor, with Councilmember McKeown as Mayor Pro Tem
  during that first year. Then in the second year, Councilmember McKeown
  as Mayor and Councilmember O’Day as the Mayor Pro Tem in the second
  year.

  The motion fails by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers McKeown, Vazquez, Himmelrich
  NOES:  Councilmembers Davis, Winterer, O’Day, Morena
  ABSENT: None

  Returning to the main motion.

  Councilmember O’Day nominated Councilmember Davis for Mayor
  Councilmember Vazquez nominated Councilmember McKeown for Mayor

  Councilmember McKeown declined the nomination for 2 years.

  Substitute motion by Councilmember Vazquez, seconded by
  Councilmember Himmelrich, to nominate Councilmember Davis for the
  first year and Councilmember McKeown for the second year as Mayor.

  The motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Morena. Himmelrich, Vazquez, McKeown
  NOES:  Councilmembers O’Day, Davis, Winterer
  ABSENT: None

  MAYOR ASSUMED THE  Mayor Davis assumed the Chair.
  CHAIR

  3  December 11, 2018
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 2C11DB0B-C8CA-4222-BB06-6B4F636BF74B

  ELECTION OF MAYOR  The Mayor opened the floor for nominations for the Mayor Pro Tempore
  PRO TEMPORE  for a two-year term.

  Councilmember Morena, nominated Councilmember O’Day for Mayor Pro
  Tem for a two-year term.

  Substitute motion by Councilmember Vazquez, seconded by
  Councilmember Himmelrich, to split the term for Mayor Pro Tem to be
  Councilmember McKeown for the first year, and Councilmember O’Day
  for the second year.

  The motion failed by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers McKeown, Vazquez, Himmelrich
  NOES:  Councilmembers Winterer, O’Day, Morena, Mayor Davis
  ABSENT: None

  Substitute motion by Councilmember Vazquez, seconded by
  Councilmember McKeown, to split the term for Mayor Pro Tem to have
  Councilmember Himmelrich for the first year, and Councilmember O’Day
  the second year.

  The motion fails by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Himmelrich, Vazquez, McKeown
  NOES:  Councilmembers Morena, O’Day, Winterer, Mayor Davis
  ABSENT: None

  Returning to the main motion.

  Councilmember Morena nominated Councilmember O’Day for a two-year
  term.
  Councilmember Vazquez nominated Councilmember Himmelrich for a
  two-year term.

  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day was appointed by the following vote:

  O’Day:  Councilmembers Winterer, O’Day, Morena, Mayor Davis
  Himmelrich: Councilmembers McKeown, Vazquez, Himmelrich

  SEATING ORDER OF  On order of the Mayor, Councilmembers draw lots for seat selection on the
  COUNCILMEMBERS  dais, in accordance to the Council Rules.

  4  December 11, 2018
